description.value: C-Lovers Fish & Chips is a BC-based chain specializing in hand-battered fish and chips, with a North Vancouver outpost on Pemberton Ave. The menu features multiple species—halibut, cod, haddock, salmon, and prawns—alongside classic sides like hand-cut chips and coleslaw. The chain participates in the Ocean Wise sustainable seafood program, indicating a commitment to responsibly sourced fish.

The website explicitly features a Take Out Menu section, confirming takeout service; no cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere on the site.
